metadata.description: Public Copilot CLI plugin marketplace: curated, reusable agents and skills organized by domain (core, meta, docs, ui).

plugins.name: core-skills
plugins.description: Broadly-useful, standalone skills: memory, browser, research-methodology, prompt-builder (situation → engineered AI-agent prompt), az (Azure CLI domain reference), narrate (doc/text → spoken-audio MP3), create-image (gpt-image-2 image generation/editing on Azure AI Foundry), grok-search (zero-cost real-time X/Twitter + web search via Grok in a logged-in browser).

plugins.name: core-agents
plugins.description: Research agent that creates citation-driven academic papers, comprehensive reports, and evidence-based analyses, and answers follow-up questions about completed research.

plugins.name: meta
plugins.description: Meta-tooling for designing and auditing Copilot agents and skills: agent-architect agent + agent-crafting, skill-crafting, agent-skill-audit, and hooks-crafting skills.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Product/work-item planning skills (no agents): write-prd, prd-to-work-items.

plugins.name: ui
plugins.description: UI design agents (ui-designer, ui-critic) and supporting skills (ui-generation, ui-critique, ui-design-system) for production-quality React/TypeScript/Tailwind UI.
